chunks: There is not a sum, large or small, that they spend, not a piece of land that they traverse (in the service of God) which is not put down in their favour, so that God could reward them for what they had done.

key_terms.لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ: So that He may reward them
key_terms.يُنفِقُونَ: They spend (in charity or God's path)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for spending wealth and traveling in the path of God according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the comprehensive nature of divine recompense, where even minor acts of charity and travel for jihad are meticulously recorded to ensure the faithful receive 'the best' of their deeds. It underscores the principle that God’s reward often exceeds the mere magnitude of the action, reflecting His generosity to those who strive in His path.
